title: 第21章 剑典第22章 你与本尊有缘
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
〈青莲剑典〉
打开金色玉简的瞬间，
一股顶级道具的气势扑面而来。
【“我本楚狂人，凤歌笑孔丘。手持三尺剑，直指九霄愁。”青莲剑典为青莲剑仙所创，其中包含基础剑法36章，剑式12式。品级为仙品。任何经脉贯通者都可修行青莲剑典，但想修至巅峰造极，剑骨、剑灵根、剑心缺一不可！】
道具确实是极品道具。
但看完介绍的陈怀安满脸古怪。
这青莲剑仙不会就是李白吧？
李白不是诗仙吗？
啥时候成剑仙了？
“算了，这年头二创什么的太正常了，唐僧都能手持加特林了，那李白成剑仙也没啥问题。”陈怀安一阵摇头晃脑。他想到李清然不就是用剑的吗？这青莲剑典完全可以给李清然使用。
仙品剑法，应该很厉害吧？
此刻青莲剑典已经打开第一页，陈怀安本以为这就只是个游戏道具，却发现第一页真的有字还有毛笔画的小人像。
“嘶——！这就是小作坊吗？恐怖如斯！！”
【剑章之一·鹤立：双腿并拢，屈膝抬起一只脚，呈鹤立状（初学者可不抬腿），身体挺直，剑直立于身体正前方与身体平行，剑柄横切与地面水平线平行，剑身贴近手臂保持垂直，呼吸平稳，沉心静气，注意力集中于剑与自身气息之交融……】
旁边配了个图方便更清晰了解这一剑章的具体操作方法。
陈怀安继续往下翻，发现还有。
【剑章之二·松展】同样有解说和图片。
【剑章之三·持锋】
【剑章之三十五·归一】
【剑章之三十六·逍遥】

他不信邪一直翻到最后，结果每个剑章都配备图文，没有一点划水！
陈怀安此刻已经为这位游戏制作人的认真和硬核叹为观止。之前被坑那么多钱的不爽也在此刻缓解了些许。
36剑章看起来是打基础的东西。
后面还有12剑式。
正要往后翻，屏幕上就弹出个提示：【你尚未学会剑章一到十二，无法阅读剑式！】
“啥玩意儿，我还得学会？我咋学？”陈怀安下意识就去找充值窗口，但是没找到，这青莲剑典似乎不是靠充钱来升级的。
【是否开始学习剑章之一？】
〈是〉
〈再想想〉
陈怀安没犹豫，直接选是。
content_en:
〈Green Lotus Sword Code〉
The moment I opened the golden jade slip,
An aura of top-notch props rushed towards him.
["I am a madman of Chu, and Feng Ge laughs at Confucius. I hold a three-foot sword and point it straight at the sky." The Qinglian Sword Code was created by the Qinglian Sword Immortal. It contains 36 chapters of basic swordsmanship and 12 sword styles. The grade is immortal grade. Anyone with well-connected meridians can practice the Green Lotus Sword Canon, but if you want to practice it to its peak, the sword bone, sword spirit root, and sword heart are indispensable! 】
The props are indeed the best.
But after reading the introduction, Chen Huaian had a weird face.
Could this Qinglian Sword Immortal be Li Bai?
Isn’t Li Bai a poet?
When did you become a swordsman?
"Forget it, second creations are so normal these days. Monk Tang can hold a Gatling, so it won't be a problem for Li Baicheng to become a swordsman." Chen Huaian shook his head for a while. He thought about Li Qingran, didn't he use a sword? This Qinglian Sword Code can be used by Li Qingran.
Immortal swordsmanship should be very powerful, right?
At this moment, the first page of the Qinglian Sword Code has been opened. Chen Huaian thought it was just a game prop, but he found that the first page actually had words and a small portrait drawn with a brush.
"Hiss! Is this a small workshop? It's so terrifying!!"
[One of the Sword Chapters: Standing in a Crane: Keep your legs together, bend your knees and lift one foot in a standing position (beginners do not need to raise their legs), keep your body straight, hold the sword straight in front of your body and parallel to your body, the hilt of the sword is cut parallel to the horizontal line on the ground, the blade of the sword is close to your arm and kept vertical, breathe steadily, calm down, and focus on the blending of the sword and your own breath...]
There is a picture next to it to help you understand more clearly the specific operation method of this sword seal.
Chen Huaian continued to scroll down and found that there were more.
[Sword Chapter 2: Song Zhan] also has explanations and pictures.
[Sword Chapter Three: Holding the Edge]
[Sword Chapter Thirty-five: Return to One]
[Sword Chapter Thirty-six·Xiaoyao]
He didn't believe in evil and kept reading until the end. As a result, each sword medal was equipped with pictures and text, without any scratches!
Chen Huaian was already amazed by the seriousness and hard-core of this game producer. The discomfort of being cheated out of so much money before was relieved a little at this moment.
36 Sword Chapter seems to be the foundation.
There are 12 sword postures at the back.
Just as he was about to turn back, a prompt popped up on the screen: [You have not learned sword chapters one to twelve and cannot read the sword posture! 】
"What the hell do I have to learn? How can I learn it?" Chen Huaian subconsciously looked for the recharge window, but couldn't find it. It seems that the Qinglian Sword Code cannot be upgraded by recharging money.
[Would you like to start learning one of the sword chapters? 】
〈Yes〉
〈Think again〉
Chen Huaian did not hesitate and chose yes directly.
